ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65 low-intensity (black) to 0.35 high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Vertical white-intensity streaks localized along the medial-distal axis of both lobes; distinct circular white rings localized in the central regions of both lobes; high-intensity mottling concentrated at the trailing edges and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees and sharp convergence at the peduncle junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with deep irregular indentations exceeding 20 pixels in depth at the distal regions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory fitted to the trailing edge boundaries, terminating in sharply jagged distal vertices on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-15 distinct circular high-contrast pixel rings (white-on-black) distributed across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of white linear pixel tracks (rake marks) oriented primarily vertically, intersecting the base pigmentation across approximately 60% of the fluke area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring patterns consisting of circular barnacle attachment marks and long-form linear rake marks; significant erosion and irregular tissue loss along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged distal tip on the left lobe, showing a non-standard pixel contour compared to typical smooth leading-edge transitions.
